MakerThink calls the same ordinary virtual spawn slot with bypass argument zero
child construction calls the CanMakeNPC virtual after caching ground and before allocation
finite successful spawn decrements remaining total and tests depletion
child death or removal tests finite depletion before decrementing the live count

TeleportToEntity typedescription handler thunk is a single jump to the native body

findings.fact: Start-disabled controls only automatic MakerThink; public Spawn remains callable but shares the normal CanMakeNPC admission path.
findings.evidence: NPCMakerSpawn 0x1034afe0 installs no think when +0x66c0 is set. InputSpawnNPC 0x1034b500 and MakerThink 0x1034bbf0 both call the ordinary spawn virtual with bypass argument zero.
findings.consequence: A faithful runtime must not reject an explicit Spawn merely because the maker is disabled, and must not let that input bypass quotas or obstruction guards.

findings.fact: CanMakeNPC tests the live-child ceiling before the scene, player visibility, view-cone, minimum-distance and ground-occupancy gates; infinite mode does not bypass the live ceiling.
findings.evidence: CanMakeNPC 0x1034b580 compares +0x66b0 against positive +0x66b4 before reading the scene gate, +0x66c1, +0x66c5, +0x66c8 and the 68-by-68 ground query. Infinite flag +0x66c3 is read by IsDepleted instead.
findings.consequence: MaxLiveChildren is the maker-local invariant that prevents simultaneous duplicate tutorial Bluebloods.

findings.fact: Timed success and live-ceiling saturation retry after SpawnFrequency; other admission failures retry after a random one-to-two seconds.
findings.evidence: MakerThink 0x1034bbf0 branches on the spawn result and the live/max-live comparison before selecting +0x6664 or RandomFloat(1.0,2.0).
findings.consequence: Visibility, distance, active-scene and occupancy failures are deferred rather than consuming quota or outputs.

findings.fact: On an accepted spawn, OnSpawnNPC fires before child spawn flags, template relationships, DispatchSpawn, maker ownership, NPCTargetname and quota updates.
findings.evidence: SpawnChild 0x1034b7b0 parses the raw template and copies type/model, calls output +0x6668, then prepares and dispatches the child; +0x66b0 increments only after dispatch and finite +0x6660 decrements afterward.
findings.consequence: Output timing and target resolution cannot be approximated as an after-spawn notification without changing observable I/O behavior.

findings.fact: Child notification is once-only; removing a still-alive child refunds finite remaining total without OnNPCDied, while a dead child fires OnNPCDied without a refund. Depletion is tested before live-count decrement.
findings.evidence: ChildDeathNotice 0x1034bc90 guards on child +0x44c, calls the IsAlive virtual, conditionally updates +0x6660 or output +0x6680, calls IsDepleted and output +0x6698, then decrements and clamps +0x66b0.
findings.consequence: Replacement capacity and OnLastNPCDied must follow native remaining-total semantics rather than a single generic alive count.

findings.fact: The tutorial blueblood_maker can accept either porch route's explicit Spawn, but MaxLiveChildren=1 rejects every later attempt while its first child remains live.
findings.evidence: The hash-pinned sp_tutorial_1 entity record authors StartDisabled=1, InfChild=1, MaxNPCCount=1, MaxLiveChildren=1 and SpawnFrequency=5; both porch output transactions target the same maker.
findings.consequence: Two simultaneous Bluebloods from this maker are a runtime divergence even if trigger-route cross-talk also occurs.

findings.fact: TeleportToEntity is a FIELD_EHANDLE input declared by CAI_BaseNPCTroika, not CAI_BaseNPC. A string argument is converted by the global entity list's first case-insensitive exact match; a final asterisk is a prefix wildcard.
findings.evidence: CAI_BaseNPCTroika record 0x105d0a2c names InputTeleportToEntity/TeleportToEntity, type 12 and handler thunk 0x100028dd. VariantConvert 0x100d05d0 calls FindEntityByName 0x100f7770 with a null start and stores INVALID_EHANDLE on a miss while returning success.
findings.consequence: The handler receives one late-converted entity handle, never a raw destination string and never every duplicate-name destination; a miss is a consumed no-op in retail.

findings.confidence: confirmed for all current corpus receiver families
findings.fact: TeleportToEntity copies the destination's absolute origin and all absolute angles, performs the empty Relink hook, schedules the general and four Troika NPC think deadlines for curtime, and forces transmission for one second.
findings.evidence: Handler 0x102c24a0 calls destination/receiver vtable pairs +0x364/+0x360 and +0x36c/+0x368, Relink thunk 0x1001514a, virtual +0x998 and ForceTransmit 0x1000e859. Jack, CNPC_VHumanCombatant vtable 0x104b7ff4 and CNPC_VHunter vtable 0x104b9784 all resolve slot 614 through thunk 0x10010f0f to 0x102c23f0, which writes curtime at +0x17c and +0x6244..+0x6250; constant 0x104454c0 is 1.0f.
findings.consequence: There is no parent guard, trace, hull or ground search, velocity reset, navigation reset, schedule clear, enemy/state change or immediate touch dispatch. For an authored queued output, the due-now think work runs on the next server frame because GameFrame services thinks before the event queue.

findings.fact: The current 23-map export corpus authors 40 TeleportToEntity wires: eight to Jack, two to warehouse guards and thirty to maker-created hunters. Every destination name exists; la_hub_1 has two point_target rows named hunter_2_spot_1.
findings.evidence: A parsed .ents join resolves all 40 output parameters. The duplicate la_hub_1 destinations are entity indices 1114 and 1115, so first-match lookup selects the earlier live entity-list entry.
findings.consequence: The tutorial's teleport_1 is an unambiguous live input, while the la_hub_1 duplicate must preserve first-match behavior rather than reject ambiguity or choose the nearest point.

findings.fact: The patch-first script_1b Enable wire is stale: UP retains the sender but removes trig_port_chopshop_door. The point_door Kill wire is live once and missing only after it destroys all six same-name targets.
findings.evidence: Original retail BSP entity 1126 is the disabled trigger_multiple and runs jackflashChopshopDoor(); UP has no matching target while entity 485 retains the zero-delay unlimited sender. UP entity 225 sends unlimited point_door.Kill and entities 1065 through 1070 initially share that targetname.
findings.consequence: These diagnostics require no receiver-handler RE or invented entities: the first is a patch-authored dangling wire and the second is expected post-cleanup refire state.

findings.fact: engine.dll's FUN_20111f30 arms SetCheckUntouch(true) then enumerates the moved entity's spatial-partition pairs and calls CServerGameEnts::MarkEntitiesAsTouching synchronously per pair before advancing; a new contact's StartTouch fires inside that call, while a stale contact's EndTouch is deferred to CServerGameDLL::GameFrame's post-entity-think step (step 4), before CEventQueue::ServiceEvents (step 6). Within one frame the new StartTouch therefore precedes the old EndTouch.
findings.evidence: engine.dll FUN_20111f30 (CTouchLinks/CTriggerMoved enumerators, notify loop at 0x201120e0); vampire.dll PhysicsMarkEntityAsTouched 0x1003dc70, PhysicsCheckForEntityUntouch 0x1003d490, CServerGameDLL::GameFrame 0x1011abc0.
findings.consequence: Elysium's ReconcilePlayerTouches currently orders all ends before all begins, which is inverted relative to retail; landed in docs/vtmb/entity_io.md as an owner-accepted divergence pending the intra-leaf order question below.

findings.fact: The partition's intra-leaf element order is not a literal BSP/tree walk in place: CSpatialPartition::EnumerateElementsInBox delegates to a handle-indexed hash/free-list container (engine.dll 0x2000e690) whose own leaf-enumeration slot forwards to a caller-supplied comparator object cached at construction, two decompile layers past what this pass reached.
findings.evidence: engine.dll FUN_20042550 calls tree vtable slot +0x20; that vtable's slot 8 (FUN_2000f390, tree_vtable_slots.txt) is itself a forwarder to **(*(int**)(this+0x70)+8), a construction-time callback, not a further tree-node walk.
findings.consequence: Settling the true intra-leaf order needs a live capture (three overlapping trigger_multiple volumes authored in different .ents orders, walked and compared by OnStartTouch firing order), not further static decompilation of this container alone.

findings.fact: CTriggerSave (trigger_autosave) overrides only Spawn and Touch over CBaseTrigger, declares no datamap of its own, and its Touch is a 12-instruction body: return if the toucher is not a player (CBaseEntity+0xA8 self-pointer), else UTIL_Remove(this) then engine->ServerCommand("autosave\n"), which Cbuf_AddText defers to the next Cbuf_Execute rather than saving inline.
findings.evidence: vampire.dll CTriggerSave::Touch 0x101c9810; CTriggerSave::Spawn 0x101c97d0; engine.dll IVEngineServer::ServerCommand 0x201095c0; Cbuf_AddText 0x2002dcc0; Host_AutoSave_f 0x20099010.
findings.consequence: A rebuild's autosave trigger deletes itself and requests an async save on first player touch only; the request can be refused (interval/autosave_on/save-blocked) with no entity left behind to retry, because the retry lives in CSaveRestore's own pending latch (SetSaveBlocked re-running Host_AutoSave_f the instant the block clears to zero).

findings.fact: CBasePlayer::PostThink (0x1016be10) unconditionally reaches CBasePlayer::SimulatePlayerSimulatedEntities (0x1017c300) regardless of which branch its live-body update takes, and PostThink itself runs from CPlayerMove::RunCommand's RunPostThink step once per usercmd CBasePlayer::ProcessUsercmds processes synchronously, not once per GameFrame.
findings.evidence: vampire.dll FUN_1016be10 label LAB_1016c41d (both the early-exit goto and the full-body fallthrough reach it) calling thunk_FUN_1017c300; CPlayerMove::RunCommand 0x101874a0 -> RunPostThink 0x10187280 -> player vtable +0x6d4 thunk 0x1000b951 -> 0x1016be10, cross-checked against docs/vtmb/game_runtime.md's already-recovered server-stage order and docs/vtmb/player-entity.md's PostThink body.
findings.consequence: The player's stale-touch drain is usercmd-cadenced rather than frame-cadenced; how many frames elapse after a teleport before the player's own touch state reconciles depends on how many usercmds that frame processes, normally exactly one in listen/single-player play.

findings.fact: Host_AutoSave_f's guard-E field (gpGlobals+0x18, 0x212af2e4) is not a raw copy of maxEntities or maxClients. engine.dll's SV_SpawnServer (0x200f55f0) computes it as 1 - (int)(-1.0 / x) from a separate global float at 0x20b42af4, then FUN_200f7e40 refreshes gpGlobals+0x18 from a mirrored sv-struct field every server frame. The arithmetic evaluates to 2 when x==1 and 1 for any larger integer x, so the guard 'gpGlobals+0x18 > 1' reduces to "this session's underlying count is exactly one" - a single-player-shaped test, not a pool-size or client-count comparison.
findings.evidence: engine.dll raw disassembly asm_200f55f0_full.txt @0x200f5b66-0x200f5bae (FLD/FDIVR/call-truncate/SUB EBP,EAX sequence writing both 0x212b094c and 0x212af2e4); FUN_200f7e40 @0x200f7e46 (DAT_212af2e4 = DAT_212b094c per frame); DumpConst confirms 0x20174040/0x20174044 is the double -1.0 divisor. 0x20b42af4 sits 4 bytes before the mem_leakdelta ConVar object in the engine ConVar census (fid/convars-engine.dll.txt), positionally consistent with mp_logecho's tail field but not confirmed by any write/registration site.
findings.consequence: The prior maxEntities hypothesis is retired. Settling the exact source global's symbolic identity needs a debugger read of dword [0x20b42af4] in-map (or its owning ConVar's registration site), not further static tracing.

findings.confidence: confirmed for codes 6/7 and the code-1 world-entity predicate; terminal-unresolved for codes 2/3/4 and code 1's +0x1EB8
findings.fact: Cross-referencing GetSaveBlockedReason's (0x10174f80) tested offsets against the recovered CBasePlayer/CBaseCombatCharacter/CBaseFlex datamap chain and decompiling its predicate callees shows codes 6 and 7 are the same +0x1db0 EHANDLE relationship split by state: code 7's predicate (0x10175180) requires that target's vtable slot +0x228 getter to equal exactly 3, while code 6's 0x101618a0 fires whenever the same handle is merely valid in any other state. Code 6 also covers the datamap-confirmed camera pair m_hCameraViewEntity (+0x19C0) / m_hCameraTargetEntity (+0x19CC) plus a related camera-cluster predicate (0x1017cf90, testing +0x1ec4 and +0x19b4). Code 1's second predicate (0x1023bd00) returns a global (0x107532e8) whose sole writer (0x1023c020) is a worldspawn-shaped initializer (soundent creation, message/chaptertitle/startdark keyfields), identifying it as the world-entity singleton. Codes 2 (+0xFE8), 3 (+0x153C/+0x1538), 4 (+0x1040), and code 1's other predicate (+0x1EB8) were checked against the complete base chain from CBasePlayer to the root CBaseEntity - CBaseCombatCharacter (305), CBaseFlex (3), CBaseAnimatingOverlay (70), CBaseAnimating (43), CBaseToggle (38), CBaseEntity (110, base=0, chain terminates) - and appear in none of them. This is a terminal static result, not an unchased lead: these four are ordinary runtime EHANDLE/int fields with no typedescription_t anywhere in the chain.
findings.evidence: DumpDatamap on 0x10580edc/0x10580f24/157 (player_datamap_full.txt, m_hCameraViewEntity/m_hCameraTargetEntity at 0x19c0/0x19cc), 0x1061664c/0x10616694/305 (cbcc_datamap.txt), 0x10559360/0x105593a4/3 (cbaseflex_fields2.txt), 0x105509f8/0x10550a3c/70 (cbao_datamap.txt), 0x1054cd70/0x1054cdb4/43 (cba_datamap.txt), 0x1059b6f0/0x1059b734/38 (cbt_datamap.txt), 0x10552e18/0x10552e5c/110 (cbe_datamap.txt, base=0); DumpFuncs decompiles of 0x10175180, 0x1017cf90, 0x101618a0, 0x1023bd00 (saveblocked_predicates.txt) and of 0x1023c020 (writer_1023c020.txt).
findings.consequence: Naming the remaining four fields and the final vtbl+0x278 (IsAlive() HYPOTHESIS) check needs a live logged walk of GetSaveBlockedReason's return across player states (idle, dialogue, terminal, feeding, climbing, cutscene, dead); no further static datamap coverage exists to chase.
